preconditions.expression: isinstance(votes, list) and all(isinstance(v, str) for v in votes)
preconditions.description: votes is a list of strings.
The number of votes is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(v) <= 26 for v in votes)
preconditions.description: Each vote string has a length between 1 and 26 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(votes) > 0 and all(len(v) == len(votes[0]) for v in votes)
preconditions.description: All vote strings have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() and c.isalpha() for c in v) for v in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in votes are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(v)) == len(v) for v in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters within a single vote string are unique.

preconditions.expression: len(votes) > 0 and all(set(v) == set(votes[0]) for v in votes)
preconditions.description: All vote strings contain exactly the same set of characters.

postconditions.description: The return value is a string.

postconditions.expression: len(votes) > 0 and set(return_value) == set(votes[0]) and len(return_value) == len(votes[0])
postconditions.description: The return string contains exactly the same set of teams as the input votes, with no duplicates and no missing teams.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value.index(t1) < return_value.index(t2)) == (count_vector(t1, votes) > count_vector(t2, votes) or (count_vector(t1, votes) == count_vector(t2, votes) and t1 < t2)) for t1 in return_value for t2 in return_value if t1 != t2)
postconditions.description: For any two distinct teams t1 and t2, t1 appears before t2 in the result if and only if t1 has more votes at the first differing position (comparing vote counts per rank index), or if vote counts are identical across all positions, t1 is alphabetically smaller than t2.

helpers.count_vector: A function count_vector(team, votes) returns a list of integers where the i-th element is the number of times 'team' appears at index i in the votes list.
